title: tc-capability-notice
description:
An advisory with an answer: the request falls where the AI is only partly proven (amber) or not proven (red) – the
task area, a capped confidence, who was notified, and a folded distance-from-usual score.

level.description: How proven the AI is for this request: "partial" (amber) or "unproven" (red)

area.description: The task area the request falls in, by the name people know it by

heading.description: The heading – what to do about the answer: "Check this answer independently" or "Treat this answer as a starting point" by default

message.description: Why – a sentence on how proven the AI is here; a default sentence per level

cap.description: The highest confidence the answer may show, e.g. "Medium"; set, the notice says "Confidence capped at …"

notified.description: Who was told about the request, e.g. "Supervisor"; set, the notice says "… notified"

distance.description: How far the request is from the ones the AI usually handles; set, the notice has a folded detail with a scale

usual.description: The score above which a request counts as unusual – marked on the scale, the usual range shaded below it

scaleMin.description: The low end of the scale

scaleMax.description: The high end of the scale

digits.description: Decimal places the score is shown with

distanceLabel.description: The name of the score – the toggle's label and the scale's name

distanceNote.description: A sentence under the scale saying what the score means

open.description: Whether the distance detail is open
